newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes end firm on active refinery squaring.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes end firm on active refinery squaring.

text.p: U.S. crudes ended strong for most sectors on Friday, but energetic advances for sweet crude grade differentials faltered late in the session.
Outright crude values rose on short covering ahead of the weekend, and Canada's Interprovincial Pipe Line closing four lines after reports of a small oil spill.

Grade prices gained from the morning on active refinery buying to square books ahead of May pipeline scheduling, Pent-up demand for barrels also played into firmer prices, as did sweet crude advances on stronger North Sea crude demand.
Sweets gave back advances later in the day, traders noted.
